result_text:
The three default-convention typos are fixed in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. The module's full test suite passes (333 run, 0 failures, 3 skipped).

- **HTML pages:** the pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator rules now match `.htm`, `.html` and `.xhtml`. The old `(html|html|xhtml)` had a duplicate `html`, which I replaced with `(htm|html|xhtml)`.
- **.NET doc and JS files:** the paths are now `.*[.]xml` and `.*[.]js`, so `MyAssembly.xml` and `app.js` match. The old `.*/[.]xml` and `.*/[.]js` only matched files named exactly `.xml` or `.js`.
- **Gradle JS:** the path is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches. The old `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` only matched `.-gradle.js`.

I also added `codeanalyzer/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventionsTest.java`. It checks the new matches, the cases that already matched, and that hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files stay out of the generated scope. It reads the default lists by reflection, since they are private and there is no public accessor.

Nothing is committed.
